Hi there, I'm Leyang 👋

Full personal homepage: https://lifeos.vip/about.

Chief Vibe Officer at Midscene & builder of Vibelet, Aino, LifeOS, Calendar Pro, and DeepAsk.

Focused on UI Automation and PKM, dedicated to maximizing productivity across work and life with AI.

🚀 Featured Projects

🤖 Midscene

AI-powered UI automation that stays debuggable.

Midscene makes UI automation stable, easy to debug, and friendly to maintain using multimodal AI.

  • Natural Language Automation: Control Playwright, Puppeteer, and Android devices with prompts.
  • Visualization: Visualized reports make prompt tuning and failure analysis inspectable.
  • Flexible Usage: Supports JavaScript SDK and codeless YAML automation flows.

📱 Vibelet

AI coding from your phone.

Vibelet is a mobile remote for Claude and Codex sessions.

  • Remote Control: Control Claude and Codex side by side, each agent in its own workspace.
  • Fast Pairing: Pair instantly with QR scanning, with remote-ready and LAN-only modes.
  • Mobile Workflow: Supports image sharing, file browsing, downloads, approvals, and session resume.

📝 Aino

AI native note-taking app.

Aino combines AI chat, Markdown editing, calendar planning, tasks, Pomodoro, habits, and life reviews into one native workspace.

  • AI Chat: Supports multi-model AI chat with note context, date ranges, and prompt templates.
  • Daily Execution: Includes Markdown editing, calendar views, task inbox, habits, and periodic reviews.
  • PKM Workflow: Brings LifeOS-style knowledge management into a dedicated native app.

🧠 LifeOS

A complete personal knowledge management system for Obsidian.

LifeOS is designed to bring structure to life and work through repeatable PKM workflows.

  • Methodology: Implements PARA and periodic notes from daily to yearly.
  • Awards: Winner of Obsidian Gem Awards 2024 Bronze in Best Template Category.
  • Ecosystem: Uses Dataview, Templater, templates, reviews, plans, and reflection rituals.

📅 Calendar Pro

A serious planning layer for Obsidian.

Calendar Pro turns Obsidian tasks into a schedulable calendar system.

  • Views: Supports month, week, day, agenda, kanban, timeline, and four-quadrant planning views.
  • Task Planning: Move tasks between sidebars, dates, time blocks, priorities, tags, and timelines.
  • Calendar Sync: Connects remote calendars with ICS and CalDAV, including iCloud and Google Calendar.

💬 DeepAsk

AI chat plugin for Obsidian.

DeepAsk brings context-aware conversations to Obsidian.

  • Vault Context: Chat with open notes, webpages, multiple files, and time-scoped context.
  • Model Support: Supports GPT, Gemini, DeepSeek, Qwen, Kimi, Claude, Ollama, and custom models.
  • Plugin Workflow: Adds poster generation, Chrome integration, prompt selection, tags, and MCP access.

🛠 Tech Stack

  • Core Focus: PKM, AI Agents, UI Automation, Mobile AI Coding.
  • Languages: TypeScript, JavaScript.
  • Automation: Playwright, Puppeteer, Android, iOS.
  • PKM / Obsidian: Obsidian, Dataview, Templater, Milkdown.
  • Infrastructure / Protocols: Cloudflare Tunnel, MCP, CalDAV, ICS.

📫 Connect with Me

  • Twitter/X: @quanruzhuoxiu
  • Blog: blog.lifeos.vip
  • Discord: LifeOS Community / Midscene Community

GPU Inference, AI Hardware & Agent Systems Engineer

CUDA/C++ · Blackwell LLM Inference · Agent Systems · Confidential Computing

I build high-performance AI systems across the complete hardware–software stack — from GPU kernels and inference runtimes to optimized models, autonomous agents, and verifiable compute infrastructure.

My foundation is in embedded Linux, firmware, real-time systems, hardware design, and silicon bring-up. My current work focuses on Blackwell-native LLM inference, model optimization, agent systems, and confidential computing.

Current Work

  • SparkInfer — native C++/CUDA inference runtime optimized for NVIDIA Blackwell GPUs

  • LLM Performance Engineering — NVFP4/FP8 quantization, speculative decoding, long-context inference, KV-cache optimization, tool calling, and RTX 5090 deployment

  • Agent Systems — personal AI agents connecting models, tools, skills, memory, communication channels, and device-local actions

  • Confidential & Verifiable Computing — trusted execution, GPU attestation, signed compute evidence, fail-closed validation, sealed evaluation, and verifiable sandbox infrastructure

  • Physical & Edge AI — Jetson, voice and perception pipelines, embedded Linux, IoT, local automation, and hardware-integrated intelligence

Engineering Focus

  • CUDA/C++ kernel and inference-runtime optimization
  • NVIDIA Blackwell architecture and quantized inference
  • LLM serving, scheduling, memory management, and latency optimization
  • Long-context inference and speculative decoding
  • Agent runtimes, tool execution, memory, and multi-step workflows
  • Confidential computing, TEE/GPU attestation, and proof-backed execution
  • Embedded Linux, firmware, and hardware–software co-design

Building

A complete AI systems stack connecting:

hardware → kernels → runtime → optimized models → agents → verified execution → physical systems

My long-term goal is to design a custom inference accelerator optimized for agent workloads.

Fast inference. Autonomous agents. Verifiable compute.
